targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date AS time, value, entity_id || ' / ' || metric AS metric FROM kpi_snapshots WHERE entity_type = 'department' AND $__timeFilter(snapshot_date) ORDER BY snapshot_date
SELECT DISTINCT ON (entity_id, metric) entity_id AS department, metric, value, snapshot_date FROM kpi_snapshots WHERE entity_type = 'department' ORDER BY entity_id, metric, snapshot_date DESC

SELECT DISTINCT ON (k.entity_id, k.metric) e.name AS employee, k.metric, k.value, k.snapshot_date FROM kpi_snapshots k LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id::text = k.entity_id WHERE k.entity_type = 'employee' ORDER BY k.entity_id, k.metric, k.snapshot_date DESC
